s1-classroom: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight down a nineteen-sixty Scottish primary school classroom, high ceiling and hanging globe lights at the top of frame, worn floorboards at the bottom. Rows of old wooden lift-lid desks with inkwells, grey winter light through tall windows, one desk near the window standing slightly apart. No people. Muted period colors, photorealistic, quiet, uneasy.
s2-street: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight along a modest nineteen-fifties Scottish council terrace street at winter dusk, heavy grey sky at the top of frame, wet pavement at the bottom. Low pebble-dashed houses with small gardens, one downstairs window lit warm, hills faint behind the rooftops. No people. Photorealistic, cold, quiet.
s3-parlour: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight across a small nineteen-sixty Scottish front room at night, low ceiling at the top of frame, patterned carpet at the bottom. A heavy dark wooden sideboard stands pulled out at an angle from the wall, drawers shut, a doily and clock on top, lit by one dim standard lamp. No people. Photorealistic, wrong, unsettling.
s4-bedroom: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight at a small nineteen-sixty child's bedroom at night, sloped ceiling at the top of frame, wooden floor at the bottom. A narrow single bed with a wooden headboard, blankets disturbed, and a plain wooden linen chest beside it, lit by a weak bedside lamp. No people. Photorealistic, cold, unsettling.
s5-recorder: Vertical portrait photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight down at a nineteen-sixty reel-to-reel tape recorder on a kitchen table under a single hanging bulb, the bulb at the top of frame, the table surface at the bottom. Both reels loaded with brown tape, dials faintly lit, a microphone on the table beside it. No people, no text. Photorealistic, stark.
s6-house-night: Vertical portrait night photograph taken from standing eye level looking straight at a modest pebble-dashed Scottish council house at night, starless sky at the top of frame, low garden wall at the bottom. Every window dark except one small upstairs window lit weak and yellow. No people. Photorealistic, cold, ominous.
